insights.concise_text: The encoder-decoder-reconstructor addresses over-translation and under-translation by using back-translation to enforce agreement between source and target sentences.

triple.subject: encoder-decoder-reconstructor
triple.object: over-translation and under-translation by back-translation

insights.concise_text: The encoder-decoder-reconstructor evaluated on English-Japanese and Japanese-English translation tasks significantly improves BLEU scores by 1.01 points on ASPEC and 1.37 points on NTCIR in English-Japanese translation.

triple.subject: encoder-decoder-reconstructor
triple.object: BLEU scores by 1.01 points on ASPEC and 1.37 points on NTCIR in English-Japanese translation

insights.concise_text: The encoder-decoder-reconstructor without pre-training worsens translation accuracy, supporting the conclusion that pre-training the forward translation model is required.

triple.subject: encoder-decoder-reconstructor without pre-training
triple.object: pre-training the forward translation model

insights.concise_text: The combined objective function of the encoder-decoder-reconstructor measures translation fluency and translation adequacy, consistent with its significant BLEU improvements on English-Japanese translation.

triple.subject: combined objective function
triple.object: significant BLEU improvements on English-Japanese translation

insights.concise_text: The encoder-decoder-reconstructor reduces redundant word occurrences and alleviates repeating and missing words in English-Japanese translation while maintaining translation quality.

triple.subject: encoder-decoder-reconstructor
triple.object: repeating and missing words in English-Japanese translation

insights.concise_text: The encoder-decoder-reconstructor uses the standard encoder-decoder as attention-based NMT proposed by DzmitryBahdana2014, which predicts output words using weights of each hidden state of the encoder.

triple.subject: encoder-decoder-reconstructor
triple.object: attention-based NMT proposed by DzmitryBahdana2014

insights.concise_text: Unlike coverage vector or PBSMT-based methods, the encoder-decoder-reconstructor uses back-translation and needs no additional parameters such as coverage vector or a PBSMT system for testing.

triple.subject: encoder-decoder-reconstructor
triple.object: coverage vector or PBSMT-based methods by using back-translation

insights.concise_text: The encoder-decoder-reconstructor directly penalizes translation mismatch by considering back-translation, whereas Meng2016 and Feng2016 attention mechanisms indirectly reduce repeating and missing words.

triple.subject: encoder-decoder-reconstructor
triple.object: Meng2016 and Feng2016 attention mechanisms

insights.concise_text: The encoder-decoder-reconstructor framework that improved BLEU scores and alleviated repeating and missing words on Chinese-English translation is evaluated here on English-Japanese and Japanese-English translation tasks.

triple.subject: encoder-decoder-reconstructor framework
triple.object: English-Japanese and Japanese-English translation tasks

insights.concise_text: The encoder-decoder-reconstructor requires slightly longer training time than baseline NMT, but decoding time remains the same with the encoder-decoder-reconstructor and baseline-NMT.

triple.subject: encoder-decoder-reconstructor
triple.object: training time but not decoding time
